summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only — no code changed)  I traced the whole path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → Vite proxy → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  What I found is that the wiring is actually correct everywhere I looked: - Watchlists and items are scoped by `user_id` in the schema, and every handler (get/post/put/delete, including item add/remove) re-checks `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` before touching a row — no cross-account leakage, no default/guest id. - The auth middleware on the watchlist router requires a valid `arca_s
